districts.name: Bidar
districts.note: Several taluks of the old Bidar district (e.g. Udgir, Ahmadpur, Nilanga) went to Bombay State.

districts.name: Kalaburagi
districts.note: Some taluks of the old Gulbarga district (e.g. Kodangal, Tandur) went to Andhra Pradesh.

districts.name: Belagavi
districts.note: Chandgad taluk of the old Belgaum district remained in Bombay State.

districts.name: Raichur
districts.note: Alampur and Gadwal taluks of the old Raichur district went to Andhra Pradesh.

districts.name: Ballari
districts.note: Transferred from Madras to Mysore State on 1 October 1953 (Andhra State Act, 1953); Adoni, Alur and Rayadurg taluks went to Andhra. Today’s Vijayanagara district (2021) is included here.

districts.name: Davanagere
districts.note: Formed in 1997, mostly from Chitradurga and Shimoga districts; its Harapanahalli taluk came from Bellary district.

districts.name: Dakshina Kannada
districts.note: Kasaragod taluk of old South Kanara went to Kerala.

districts.name: Chamarajanagara
districts.note: Kollegal taluk (including today’s Hanur area) belonged to Coimbatore district of Madras State and was transferred to Mysore State in 1956.

states.name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
